nodes.summary: For independent `X ~ Po(a)` and `Y ~ Po(b)` with `a + b > 0`, the law of `X` given `X + Y = N` is binomial `Bin(N, a / (a + b))`.
nodes.title: Poisson conditioning, two cells

nodes.summary: Let `Xᵢ ~ Po(λᵢ)`, `i ∈ ι`, be independent Poisson counts with `∑ᵢ λᵢ > 0`. Given their total `∑ᵢ Xᵢ = N`, the count vector is multinomial with `N` throws and cell probabilities `λᵢ / ∑ⱼ λⱼ`: `P(X = x | ∑ᵢ Xᵢ = N) = multinomialReal N (λ / ∑ λ) x`.
nodes.title: Poisson conditioning

nodes.summary: The mass of the multinomial PMF at `x` is `multinomialReal N p x`.
nodes.title: Mass of the multinomial distribution at a count vector

nodes.summary: On the simplex the multinomial mass is `N! / ∏ᵢ xᵢ! · ∏ᵢ pᵢ ^ xᵢ`.
nodes.title: Multinomial mass formula on the simplex

nodes.summary: The multinomial mass function is nonnegative for a nonnegative vector `p`.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the multinomial mass function

nodes.summary: The multinomial mass function vanishes outside the finite set `piAntidiag univ N` of count vectors with total `N`: the support is contained in the antidiagonal. Equality of the support with the antidiagonal needs all `p i > 0` (e.g. for `p = (1, 0)`, `N = 1` the vector `(0, 1)` is in the antidiagonal but has mass `0`).
nodes.title: Support of the multinomial mass lies in the antidiagonal

nodes.summary: The multinomial mass function vanishes off the simplex `∑ᵢ xᵢ = N`.
nodes.title: Multinomial mass vanishes off the simplex

nodes.summary: The multinomial mass function: the probability `N! / ∏ᵢ xᵢ! · ∏ᵢ pᵢ ^ xᵢ` that `N` independent throws, landing in cell `i` with probability `pᵢ`, produce the cell counts `x`; it is `0` unless `∑ᵢ xᵢ = N`. The formula is a polynomial in `p` and is defined for every real vector `p`; it is a probability mass function when `p` is a probability vector (`0 ≤ pᵢ`, `∑ᵢ pᵢ = 1`), which the normalization theorems assume. The…
nodes.title: Multinomial mass function

nodes.summary: The multinomial law of `N` throws with cell probabilities `p` (a probability vector), as a probability mass function on count vectors `ι → ℕ`.
nodes.title: Multinomial distribution as a probability mass function

nodes.summary: For a probability vector (`0 ≤ pᵢ`, `∑ₗ pₗ = 1`), `Cov(Xᵢ, Xⱼ) = ∑ₓ (xᵢ - N pᵢ) (xⱼ - N pⱼ) P(x) = N (δᵢⱼ pᵢ - pᵢ pⱼ)`; in particular `Var Xᵢ = N pᵢ (1 - pᵢ)` and `Cov(Xᵢ, Xⱼ) = -N pᵢ pⱼ` for `i ≠ j`.
nodes.title: Covariance

nodes.summary: For `i ≠ j`, `∑ₓ xᵢ xⱼ P(x) = N (N - 1) pᵢ pⱼ (∑ₗ pₗ) ^ (N - 2)` for every real vector `p`.
nodes.title: Second factorial moment, polynomial form

nodes.summary: For a probability vector and `i ≠ j`, `E[Xᵢ Xⱼ] = N (N - 1) pᵢ pⱼ`.
nodes.title: Mixed second moment

nodes.summary: `∑ₓ xᵢ P(x) = N pᵢ (∑ⱼ pⱼ) ^ (N - 1)` for every real vector `p`.
nodes.title: Mean, polynomial form

nodes.summary: For a probability vector (`0 ≤ pᵢ`, `∑ⱼ pⱼ = 1`), `E Xᵢ = N pᵢ`. The underlying `sum_mul_multinomialReal_eq` is a polynomial identity holding for every real `p`.
nodes.title: Mean

nodes.summary: `∑ₓ xᵢ (xᵢ - 1) P(x) = N (N - 1) pᵢ² (∑ₗ pₗ) ^ (N - 2)` for every real vector `p`.
nodes.title: Second factorial moment, polynomial form

nodes.summary: For a probability vector, `E[Xᵢ (Xᵢ - 1)] = N (N - 1) pᵢ²`.
nodes.title: Second factorial moment

nodes.summary: `∑ₓ P(x) = (∑ᵢ pᵢ) ^ N` for every real vector `p`.
nodes.title: Multinomial theorem

nodes.summary: For `∑ᵢ pᵢ = 1` the multinomial masses sum to one.
nodes.title: Normalization

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
